description: Tool set of the gather and review kits (gather/tools.json and review/tools.json are the same file, kept in step by tests/kits): read, write (only in the workspace, by convention), mail, goal, and from the comm pack only board_read and board_wait; no shell, delete, events, subagent, def, jsonx or kernel_gate; self keeps only self_state, so the agent has no tool for lifting its own limits; write and edit still take absolute paths and can reach the tools.json in its own stack, so only the rules keep it from editing that file by hand.
